To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
fibrinogen and its degradation products are independent risk factors for thrombotic disease.
fibrinogen and its degradation products are independent predictors of thrombosis.
both fibrinogen (in the plasma) and its degradation products (in the plasma and urine) are independent predictors of thrombotic events.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new risk markers of ischemic heart diseases and the development of new strategies for the prevention of ischemic heart and cerebrovascular diseases.
the role of fibrinogen in the development of atherosclerosis and its clinical sequelae.
the role of fibrinogen as a risk factor and with the use of fibrin degradation products as risk predictors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the evidence is insufficient to recommend routine measurement of either fibrinogen or fibrin D‐Dimer in the assessment of risk for ischemic heart disease in asymptomatic individuals, but that the evidence is sufficient to support further research in this area.

the association of fibrinogen with coronary events is established, but that the association of D‐dimer is not yet fully established, and that the causal significance of these associations is not yet established.
fibrinogen is a risk factor for coronary artery disease.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the plasma levels of fibrinogen, and to a lesser extent fibrin D‐dimers, are independent risk predictors of ischemic events.
the fibrinogen system has a role in atherothrombotic events, but that the role of fibrinogen per se is less than that of the fibrinolytic system.
the fibrinolytic system is a major contributor to the risk of thrombotic events.
The main takeaway from our work is that
fibrinogen is a risk factor for cardiovascular disease and that it is an interesting target to reduce risk.
there is a need to better characterize the relationship of these markers with cardiovascular risk.
the fibrinolytic system is a major determinant of cardiovascular disease risk.
